human_review.text: Do not use this dataset for this question. A person must resolve every Blocked finding first.

limitations: This is a research data-readiness screen. It is not a clinical tool and makes no claim of clinical validity, regulatory compliance, or production readiness.
Identifier detection is heuristic. A pass does not guarantee that no personal information is present.
Leakage detection checks one feature at a time and can miss leakage spread across several features.
Thresholds (events per parameter, minimum subgroup size, missingness) are configurable defaults, not clinical standards.
Subgroup coverage uses minimum counts and does not compare against a reference population.

findings.reason: Only 17 records in the smaller outcome class; too few to develop or evaluate a model.
findings.remedy: Use a larger cohort or a more common outcome.
findings.reconsider: At least 20 records in the smaller outcome group.
findings.uncertainty: Exact count; no sampling uncertainty applies to this check.
findings.effect_on_intended_use: Too few events make estimates unstable and models overfit. The data can't support this question as asked.
findings.evidence_or_source: Measured minority_class_n = 17. Rule EVT-001 (minority_class_n < 20 -> BLOCKED), policy v0.5.1, on synthea_breast_cohort.
findings.limitation: 10 events per model parameter is a rule of thumb, not a sample-size calculation.

findings.reason: Field 'tumor_size' is missing for 26% of the cohort.
findings.remedy: Plan and document an imputation strategy, or drop the field.
findings.reconsider: A documented imputation plan, or the result with and without that field.
findings.uncertainty: max_feature_missing_rate = 26.1% (95% range 19.9% to 33.5%); the range crosses the rule's threshold, so this finding is borderline
findings.effect_on_intended_use: Missing values shrink the group that can be analysed and can bias it. Usable for this question only after the next step is taken and reported.
findings.evidence_or_source: Measured max_feature_missing_rate = 0.261. Rule CMP-004 (max_feature_missing_rate > 0.2 and max_feature_missing_rate <= 0.5 -> CONDITIONAL), policy v0.5.1, on synthea_breast_cohort.
findings.limitation: Counts missing values; it can't tell why they are missing.

findings.reason: Some subgroups are too small to evaluate model behavior reliably: race=black (n=12), race=asian (n=10), race=other (n=5), race=hawaiian (n=2), race=native (n=1).
findings.remedy: Report subgroup performance with uncertainty, or obtain more data for these groups.
findings.reconsider: More records for those groups, or results reported with uncertainty.
findings.uncertainty: Exact count; no sampling uncertainty applies to this check.
findings.effect_on_intended_use: With few patients in a group, the model's behaviour in that group can't be judged. Usable for this question only after the next step is taken and reported.
findings.evidence_or_source: Measured n_small_subgroups = 5. Rule SUB-002 (n_small_subgroups > 0 -> CONDITIONAL), policy v0.5.1, on synthea_breast_cohort.
findings.limitation: Minimum counts only; no comparison with a reference population.

spec.question_text: Can we model 5-year overall survival in breast cancer patients diagnosed since 2012 from stage, receptor status, tumor size and age, and compare across race?

report.text:
**Verdict: Blocked** for the question: "Can we model 5-year overall survival in breast cancer patients diagnosed since 2012 from stage, receptor status, tumor size and age, and compare across race?"

Why:
- [EVT-001] (Blocked) Only 17 records in the smaller outcome class; too few to develop or evaluate a model.
- [CMP-004] (Conditional) Field 'tumor_size' is missing for 26% of the cohort.
- [SUB-002] (Conditional) Some subgroups are too small to evaluate model behavior reliably: race=black (n=12), race=asian (n=10), race=other (n=5), race=hawaiian (n=2), race=native (n=1).

To make this dataset ready for this question:
- [EVT-001] Use a larger cohort or a more common outcome.
- [CMP-004] Plan and document an imputation strategy, or drop the field.
- [SUB-002] Report subgroup performance with uncertainty, or obtain more data for these groups.
